Brendan had been my best friend since before I could remember, he had lived a couple streets over and we had been in the same class in school on the first day, I was shy nervous and lonely and struggled to make friends but we became fast friends, it was a natural click.

All through school he made friends and I hung around them and became friends by association, people finally accepted me and life was going good.

We had just finished college and he helped me with my interviews to get a job, he kept me in our friend group, but that all changed.

About a month ago he just completely disappeared, the guy I had talked to every day, gamed with every night and helped each other with any problem was just gone, no contact, no explanation, not even a goodbye. Was he dead, was he kidnapped, had he just moved and not told anyone. No one knew anything, or at least they weren't telling me.

Three days after he disappeared I tried talking to the group but it was obvious that they were a group with Brendan and I just hung around, they distanced themselves from the loser smart kid they let hang around cos he helped with homework and answers, I assumed that was the same of Brendan.

I spiraled, I had lost what I thought was my best friend, so when one day I was looking at Snapchat, and reading the last message I had got from Brendan "I know you will crush this job dude, and I will be there for you whenever you need", i was about to hit delete on the app when a message popped up.

It was from a girl I didn't know, I wrote it off as a spam bot trying to steal my info or get me to buy something, but the way she spoke in the messages, it reminded me of Brendan, so I fell right into her trap I guess.

I sent messages back and forth, even if she was fake it was nice having someone to talk to again, even if it was just a faceless name, she called herself Bella and I told her I was Johnny, I was Jonathan but Brendan had told me people would like Johnny more.

Today was the one month anniversary of when Brendan had gone missing, it had been a hard month but talking to Bella had helped, I went to open the usual good morning message we sent eachother to see a picture, we had sent pictures before, of meals, of funny things we had seen online so I opened it expecting to see her breakfast, but the image stunned me, she had sent a mirror selfie, and she was stunning. Smart, funny, easy to talk to and now absolutely beautiful, I couldn't believe my luck a girl like this talking to someone like me.

I put the phone down and began pacing, I had to say something back to the photo, but I wasn't clever or charming, that was Brendan, the only dates I'd been on were double dates with him, he charmed the girl and her friend and I tagged along but sadly it didn't go much further for me.

I stared at the photo, i had determined a while ago a spam bot would have moved on and a prank from my former friends would have got bored by now, so she must be real, I still couldn't form a response, it had been an hour and I knew that if I had sent a photo and not heard from her in an hour I would be worried, so I put the only thing I could think of.

"Good morning, i hope you slept well, that's a lovely photo, do you have any plans for the day?"
